scripts.api:schema: cd ../app && uv run python -c "import django,os,json;os.environ.setdefault('DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE','core.settings');django.setup();from api.api import api;json.dump(api.get_openapi_schema(),open('../frontend/openapi.json','w'),indent=1,default=str)"
scripts.api:types: bun run api:schema && openapi-typescript openapi.json -o app/types/api.d.ts
